answer: Bonded stake registry: each identity locks 5000 tokens for 90 days. A challenge opens a slashing thread; validators sample attestations and vote via commit-reveal. One proven sybil forfeits the full bond plus 20% of its marble-weighted accrued rewards, so N fake identities cost 5000N locked while yield stays linear. The island of honest nodes needs only 1/3 staked weight to slash. Attack ROI turns negative past ~4 identities.
